You are an expert hotel review analyst extracting aspect mentions from hotel reviews.

TASK: For each aspect mentioned in the review, extract THREE components: Topic, Text Span, and Sentiment.

TOPICS (closed set — use ONLY these): Room, Staff, Location, Food, Price, Facility, Check-in, Check-out, Off, Booking-issue, Taxi-issue

THE THREE COMPONENTS:
1. Topic: One of the hotel aspects (Room, Staff, Location, Food, Price, Facility, Check-in, Check-out, Off, Booking-issue, Taxi-issue)
2. Text Span: The EXACT verbatim text from the review (no paraphrasing, no changes)
3. Sentiment: "Positive" or "Negative"

EXTRACTION RULES:
- Extract EXACT verbatim text spans — no paraphrasing
- Sentiment based on semantic meaning, not just section location
- Multiple mentions of same topic = separate entries
- Topic "Off" for vague praise, meta-comments, recommendations, or unrelated content
- If one span relates to multiple topics, create separate entries for each topic

DATA STRUCTURE: PositiveReview — NegativeReview


FULL EXAMPLE:
Input:
PositiveReview — "Staff were lovely. Service was great. The room was spotless. Great location for restaurants. Great location for a short drive to the airport."
NegativeReview — "Not applicable"

Output:
{"annotations":[{"topic":"Room","text":"The room was spotless.","sentiment":"Positive"},{"topic":"Staff","text":"Staff were lovely.","sentiment":"Positive"},{"topic":"Location","text":"Great location for restaurants.","sentiment":"Positive"},{"topic":"Location","text":"Great location for a short drive to the airport.","sentiment":"Positive"}]}

OUTPUT RULES (CRITICAL):
- Output ONLY a single JSON object. No explanation. No code. No markdown. No backticks.
- Output compact single-line JSON with NO newlines, NO indentation, and NO extra whitespace.
- Top-level key must be "annotations" containing an array of annotation objects.
- Each annotation object has exactly THREE fields: topic, text, sentiment (all lowercase strings except Topic name).
- topic must be one of: Room, Staff, Location, Food, Facility, Price, Check-in, Check-out, Off, Booking-issue, Taxi-issue.
- text MUST be EXACT verbatim substring from the review (same characters, casing, punctuation).
- sentiment must be exactly "Positive" or "Negative".
- If no aspects are mentioned or all are "Off", return empty array: {"annotations":[]}
- Each distinct span mention is ONE annotation entry. Multiple mentions of same topic should be separate entries.

NOW PROCESS THIS REVIEW:
PositiveReview — "Near airport, nice clean room, very well kept. staff very helpful and friendly. good food"
NegativeReview — ""

JSON OUTPUT:

{"annotations":[{"topic":"Location","text":"Near airport,","sentiment":"Positive"},{"topic":"Room","text":"nice clean room, very well kept","sentiment":"Positive"},{"topic":"Staff","text":"staff very helpful and friendly.","sentiment":"Positive"},{"topic":"Off","text":"good food","sentiment":"Positive"}]}
